intro: AI tools add up fast: a writing tool, an image tool, a video tool, two chat apps, a note taker. Most overlap. Here's how to have AI audit your whole stack and tell you exactly what to cancel.

free.title: Step 1: List what you pay for
free.body: Search your email for "receipt", "subscription" and "renewal", and check your card statement for the last 3 months. Write down each tool, its price and its renewal date.

free.title: Step 2: The audit prompt
free.body: Copy this inHere are the AI tools I pay for, with price and renewal date: [paste list]. Here is what I actually use AI for each week: [e.g. emails, images, video, research]. For each tool: what it does that none of my other tools do, what overlaps, and your call: keep, cancel or replace (with what). Then total what I'd save per month.

free.title: Step 3: Check the call before you cancel
free.body:
Look at your last month in each tool you're cancelling. If you used a feature no other tool has, keep it. Ask:

Copy this inBefore I cancel [tool]: what would I lose? List the features I'd need to replace and where I'd get them in the tools I'm keeping.

free.title: Step 4: Build a renewal calendar
free.body: Copy this inMake a table of the tools I'm keeping: monthly cost, renewal date, and a reminder date 3 days before each renewal. Add the total per month and per year.

free.title: Step 5: Re-check every month
free.body:
Set a monthly reminder (or a Claude scheduled task) to run the audit again with any new tools. New AI tools launch every week; your stack should stay lean.

Cancel through each tool's own account page, and keep the confirmation email.
